author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
One challenge of conservators everywhere is how to assess and analyze an artifact -- such as this 1808 pastel of Philadelphia businessman Michael Gratz -- safely and non-invasively. In our FIRST visit to Smithsonian's @nationalportraitgallery, contract paintings conservator Anna Ersenkal shows Adam Savage how she and her team use ultraviolet induced visible fluorescence photography and infrared imaging to uncover a painting's secrets and inform next steps in the conservation and/or restoration process.

National Portrait Gallery: https://npg.si.edu/
Portrait details: https://npg.si.edu/object/npg_NPG.66.14
More on Gratz: https://www.amrevmuseum.org/news/now-on-view-gratz-family-artifacts-exploring-american-jewish-life-in-philadelphia
